messages.subject: occuMulti for RN-models
parts:
Hi community!

I am new here, and have some questions about occuMulti function.
I modeled giant anteater occupancy with RN-model (occuRN) and now I need to model giant anteater - dog co-occurrence. I read about the occuMulti function be a generalization from Mackenzie single-species occupancy. Can I use this function once I used RN-model for single species? Does it have some other function I can model co-occurrence from RN models?

I tried Mackenzie single-species modelling for giant anteater but I had high overdispersion and poor models.

Thanks all!

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: occuMulti for RN-models
parts:
Hi Jessica,

There is no equivalent version of occuMulti for RN models in unmarked. As far as I know no such model exists, more generally.

Ken
